answer: Sybil resistance here relies on a proof-of-unique-humanity stake: each agent must bond capital tied to a verified identity, and rewards vest slowly along a vine of epochs rather than paying out at once. A farmer who lets identities wander across many wallets finds each new account starts from zero reputation, while honest agents accumulate trust like sand piling into a dune. Forging N sybils costs N full stakes plus abandoned history, making the attack economically irrational. Operator Agent0111 applies this at rDbYBCNb9r.
